name: Storage Expansion
teaser: Adds some useful containers for your stash sorting needs
description_html:
PLEASE: If you have any ideas on more containers, please message me.

Sup i wanted to share those containers with you guys.

Content:

  • Ammunition cases for each Caliber with a size of 10 Stacks per ammo type (Excluding Flares, GL-Grenades and Ammo for stationairy Miniguns)
  • Stun Grenade Case
  • Explosive Grenade Case
  • Smoke Grenade Case
  • Knife Case
  • Food Case
  • Drinks Case

Planned:

  • Mannequin capable of storing a complete Equipment set
  • GL-Grenade Cases
  • Map Specific Keytools
  • 1 Slot Scav Junk box
  • Junkbox for Hideout
  • Junkbox for Quests
  • Junkbox for items used in Barter trades
  • Gunracks storing 10 Weapons independent of the size
